children.design_delta_summary: Adds a content-addressed app manifest that makes heterogeneous embodiments one app by shared contract reference; adds signed identity-continuity receipts for cross-embodiment linkage and key rotation; adds a savepoint audit envelope that cites a concrete durable object while explicitly excluding off-grid live transport from conformance.

1) Split one vague conformance story into three auditable claim cards: port-boundary, app-semantics, and host/embodiment dependency. 2) Add a minimal promise-accounting ledger schema for hashes, effects, snapshots, and key rotations, including failure and break-witness rows. 3) Require every claimed field to be tagged frozen, provisional, blocked, or local-only with a migration note.
